description: Configurable dashboard with a CSS grid layout, drag-and-drop widget positioning, resize handles, edit mode, widget selector modal, multiple saved dashboards via IDashboardProvider, and JS interop for grid interactions.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto measures the dashboard and reports the mode on data-layout. The grid restacks by container query regardless (12 columns, 6 below 1024px, 2 below 768px, 1 below 640px). A forced value reports that mode without measuring.

parameters.name: LayoutModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered layout changes.

usedAbstractions.name: IDashboardProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Provider for dashboard widget data and persistence

examples.title: Basic dashboard with provider
examples.code:
<TmDashboard DashboardId="@dashId"
             UserId="@userId"
             ShowTitle="true"
             AllowEdit="true"
             OnDashboardChanged="HandleDashboardChanged">
    <WidgetTemplate Context="widget">
        @switch (widget.WidgetId)
        {
            case "sales-chart":
                <SalesChartWidget />
                break;
            case "recent-orders":
                <RecentOrdersWidget />
                break;
        }
    </WidgetTemplate>
</TmDashboard>
